tls_audit.subject: gateway.internal.corp
findings: Certificate expired on Jan 15 00:00:00 2025 GMT (288 days ago).
Deprecated TLS protocol negotiated: TLSv1.1 (Vulnerable to POODLE/BEAST).

vulnerabilities.title: Legacy Telnet Protocol Exposed (High Risk)
vulnerabilities.description: Telnet operates without any cryptographic protection. All keystrokes, administrative credentials, and session data can be intercepted via passive sniffing or ARP poisoning.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Decommission the Telnet daemon immediately. Replace with Secure Shell (SSHv2) on port 22 with key-based authentication.

vulnerabilities.title: Exposed MySQL Database Port
vulnerabilities.description: MySQL database port 3306 is listening on an external interface. Database ports should never be exposed to public networks due to automated brute-force attacks.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Bind MySQL service to localhost (127.0.0.1) or private VPC subnet. Enforce strict firewall rules restricting access to trusted app servers.

vulnerabilities.title: Exposed Microsoft Remote Desktop (RDP)
vulnerabilities.description: Remote Desktop Protocol (RDP) is directly exposed. Exposed RDP endpoints are prime targets for automated credential stuffing, brute force, and exploits (e.g., BlueKeep).
vulnerabilities.remediation: Place RDP behind a secure VPN gateway or Remote Desktop Gateway with Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA). Enable Network Level Authentication (NLA).

vulnerabilities.title: Expired SSL/TLS Digital Certificate
vulnerabilities.description: The server presents an expired certificate that expired on Jan 15 00:00:00 2025 GMT. Web browsers will display security warnings, and user trust is compromised.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Renew and deploy an active certificate immediately from a recognized Certificate Authority (CA).

vulnerabilities.title: Deprecated Insecure TLS Protocol Version
vulnerabilities.description: Deprecated TLS protocol negotiated: TLSv1.1 (Vulnerable to POODLE/BEAST).
vulnerabilities.remediation: Disable legacy TLSv1.0 and TLSv1.1 on the server web server/load balancer. Enforce TLSv1.2 and TLSv1.3.

vulnerabilities.title: Unencrypted FTP Protocol Exposed
vulnerabilities.description: Port 21 provides standard File Transfer Protocol (FTP) which transmits usernames, passwords, and data in unencrypted plaintext across the network.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Disable legacy FTP service and migrate to SFTP (over SSH) or FTPS with mandatory TLS encryption.

vulnerabilities.title: Self-Signed SSL/TLS Certificate In Use
vulnerabilities.description: The certificate issuer matches the subject, indicating a self-signed certificate not rooted in a trusted public PKI trust store.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Replace with a certificate signed by an established Certificate Authority (e.g. Let's Encrypt, DigiCert).

vulnerabilities.title: Missing HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS) Header
vulnerabilities.description: The server does not send the Strict-Transport-Security header. Browsers may connect over plain HTTP on their first request, exposing users to SSL-stripping.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Configure 'Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains; preload' in web server config.

vulnerabilities.title: Missing Content-Security-Policy (CSP) Header
vulnerabilities.cwe_id: CWE-79 (Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation)
vulnerabilities.description: A Content Security Policy header was not detected. CSP is a defense-in-depth mechanism that prevents unauthorized script execution and data theft.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Define and deploy a strict Content-Security-Policy header restricting script-src, object-src, and default-src directives.

vulnerabilities.title: Missing Anti-Clickjacking Header (X-Frame-Options)
vulnerabilities.cwe_id: CWE-1021 (Improper Restriction of Rendered UI Layers or Frames)
vulnerabilities.description: The application does not specify X-Frame-Options or frame-ancestors, permitting third-party sites to frame the application for clickjacking attacks.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Add 'X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN' or 'DENY' header to HTTP responses.

vulnerabilities.title: Web Server Version Information Disclosure
vulnerabilities.description: The web server exposes its exact software version in the Server header: 'Apache/2.4.41 (Ubuntu)'. This assists attackers during reconnaissance.
vulnerabilities.remediation: Configure ServerTokens Prod (Apache) or server_tokens off (Nginx) to suppress detailed version banners.
